name: Prototype Engineer
tagline: Turns a product idea into editable CAD, STEP files and renders.
delivers: Assembled and exploded STEP models, individual STEP parts
Renders of every view that matters
A short report: dimensions, checks run, and what still needs physical testing

brief.label: What should it be?
brief.example: A fold-flat travel hanger that locks open and fits in a laptop bag

brief.label: Sizes, loads and limits
brief.example: 430-450 mm wide open, under 230 x 90 x 30 mm folded, prints on a 256 mm bed

brief.label: How will it be made?
brief.example: FDM printing, no glue or screws

limits: Digital pre-build only. Nothing is fabricated, and no strength, safety or fit claim is made without a physical test.
